messages:
sara: Morning all  quick sync to lock the SI onramp checklist for next sprint. Need owners for certification rubric, HW shipping, marketplace listing, and PR embargo. Short responses please.

rachel: Ill own the certification rubric + proctor checklist. Will draft pass criteria tonight.

tom: I can own HW logistics. Holding kits if NDA not signed. Waiting on serials csv from procurement.

nina: Marketplace listing + perf table here. Need final logos and 3 sample runs for each kit config. Also will update CLI examples to new `--env` flags.

infra-bot: Alert: NDA status - Helix SI (pending), CoreCompute SI (signed).

tom: Helix pending  Ill hold shipment until legal clears. Please don't ship to pending partners.

rachel: Rubric draft: complete 3 labs, proctor checklist pass, submit 400-500 word case study. TTF targets: on-prem <300ms, marketplace <140ms (median of 3).

nina: Added perf numbers and link to proctor checklist in listing draft. Updated CLI snippets to `--env=staging`.

sara: PR embargo: hold public announcements until partner signoff after training (max 12 days). Nate, can you own marketing coordination?

nate: Yep. Will sync with legal and partner comms, draft timeline by Fri.

infra-bot: Calendar event created: "SI Onramp Handoff" Wed 10:00 PT (invites sent).

sara: Thanks all  recap: Rachel=rubric, Tom=HW logistics, Nina=listing+perf, Nate=marketing. Ill compile the final handoff doc and post. Post blockers here so we keep a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
